Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
Emile Bosman expounded:

> Abyssal Hunter deals one damage to a ready minion during you're untap
> phase.
>
> If I have 5 Abyssal Hunters in play can I asign the damage from all
> the hunters to one vampire with only 3 blood?

Nope. They are effects that have to be ordered and resolved
indivisually.

Messages.Author: Metropolis
Messages.Body:
> Abyssal Hunter deals one damage to a ready minion during you're untap
> phase.

Incorrect. AH does one damage to a ready vampire. There effects are
ordered. You could put 1 damage on the vampire with 3 blood 4 times. Then
after he was in torpor, you would need to choose a different vampire.

nope. you must sequence the damaging effects during your untap phase.
the vamp with 3 blood will be torporized at the 4th damage he received. The
fifth abyssal hunter will (and must) inflict damage to another ready vampire
of your choice.

fourth, then he's in torpor. In torpor, he won't be a legal target for
the fifth.
